posts.author: Froskur
posts.body:
I have been a fan of RPG Maker for a LONG time, started a couple projects, but never finished.  I got the bug again when Steam had a big sale on RPG Maker applications. Being a huge fan of Earthdawn by FASA since '93, and since there isn't one out there for me to play, I thought I would create an adventure after reading that XP would allow me to customize and create anything I had in mind.
I am a computer science programming college instructor specializing in Java, C++/C#, but I know many other business languages, not Ruby, but shouldn't take me long to pick up.
After pawing around this site and a couple others I thought I would ask the amazing RPGM gurus if what I want to do is feasible and "easily" attainable before I start this journey.
Change "Level" to "Circle"
Each character's Circle adds a set of Skills
Characters gain Legend instead of XP
Skills must be trained & paid for with a trainer using Legend and Silver
When X number of Skills reach Y level, the character reaches the next Circle
Thanks for your time.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Pretty much anything is feasible here. One way to avoid crafting many scripts for your game would be to make it harder to reach a new Circle (old fashioned level) so every level would add several skills by default using the Class skills mechanism already in effect. Then you'd need to block the level up by earning enough XP. Like commenting out the @level += 1 and @level -= 1 parts of Game_Actor found inside the exp= method.
No. 4 would simply require an event that handles that either per event or by calling some common event.
#5 would certainly force you to come up with a new script to implement it.
